title: Smoked Kielbasa and Sauerkraut Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Polish-inspired dish featuring smoked kielbasa and tangy sauerkraut, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the kielbasa and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, caraway seeds, and apple cider vinegar. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
